page.layout: One page of running text, with a numbered canon at the top and a short paragraph below it. Two notes stand in the right margin: "2.Thra-cicum." beside Canon 3 and "3. M. don." beside Canon 4.

main_text.p: Canon 3. Thracia in Sapæos, Odrysas, & Galatas divisa est.2.Thra-cicum.

Regnum Thraciæ constituit Lysimachus: quo interfecto, terræ mo-tiones Thraciam divisere. Galatæ ex Galliâ in Græciam profecti in Thraciâ qvoqve regnum constituerunt, ut Polybius observavit. Ex qvo fabula illorum re-dargu'tur, qvi Galatas Duce Brenno in spoliatione templi Delphici ful-minibus & terræ motibus extinctos tradidere. Namid confictum fuis-se à Græcis Polybius l. 4. v. 46. osten-dit, ac Galatas magno numero in Thraciam migrasse, ibiqve regnum celebre condidisse; cujusqve & Re-ges recenset.
Canon 4. Macedonia post varios mo-3. M. don.

page.notes: The right-margin note "3. M. don." is split across lines and its second part is hard to read; it may be "3. Macedonum" or similar, so the exact reading is uncertain. The word "Namid" appears as printed with a small gap, possibly "Nam id". The text continues onto the next page after "mo-". Some italic words (Galatas, Brenno, Polybius) are italic in the scan.
